payload.name: IncludeCommunityWritingInCreativeWorkSearch
payload.description: When a question asks what kind of writing or creative work someone does, search for community participation (forum posts, comments, discussions, reviews) in addition to formal writing projects before answering.
content: When a question asks what kind of writing or creative content someone produces, do not limit queries to 'writing', 'articles', 'stories', or 'novel'; include community-writing terms such as 'forum', 'comments', 'discussion', 'posts', and 'reviews' in query expansions and keywords.

Treat memories about joining an online community, discussion group, or forum and sharing thoughts on favorite topics as potential evidence of that person's writing, even when the memory does not contain the word 'write' or 'writing'.

If the initial search returns only formal writing projects (e.g., articles, books), run at least one additional search targeting community participation before answering, so comments and reviews are not omitted.

solves: When a question asks broadly what kind of writing or creative work someone does, retrieval can miss community-writing activities (forum posts, comments, discussions, reviews) because queries target formal terms like 'articles' or 'novel'. This skill expands search vocabulary to text-producing community activities and accepts participation memories as writing evidence, ensuring complete answers; it is not needed when the question targets one specific formal work or genre.
